_meta.description: Lifewarden subclass passives: 3 stat-based (max 20 levels each). Focus: healing power, HoTs, thorns, HP regen.

subclass_passives.description_fr: +1.2% puissance de soin et +0.5% soins reçus par niveau. Ce qui pousse lentement pousse solidement.
subclass_passives.description_en: +1.2% healing power and +0.5% healing received per level. What grows slowly grows solid.

subclass_passives.description_fr: +1% dégâts d'épines et +0.5 puissance de bouclier par niveau. Le rosier ne demande rien, il se contente de piquer.
subclass_passives.description_en: +1% thorns damage and +0.5 shield power per level. The rose bush asks for nothing, it simply pricks.

subclass_passives.description_fr: +1% PV max et +0.8 régén PV/s par niveau. On ne déracine pas ce qui a pris le temps de descendre.
subclass_passives.description_en: +1% max HP and +0.8 HP regen/s per level. What took time to go down does not get pulled up.
